question: A and B together can do a piece of work in 16 days. If A is 50% less efficient than B, then in how many days can A, working alone, complete the entire work?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**A is 50% less efficient than B means, 

A is 1/2 less than B 

Efficiency of A = 1, and B = 2 then,

A and B completed total work in 16 days

Total work = Efficiency × Total time taken

Total work = (1 + 2) × 16 

⇒ 48

A can completed the total works in,

 ⇒ 48/1 = **48 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__****Given:****A and B together can do a piece of work in 16 days. If A is 50% less efficient than B.**

**Concept used:**

Efficiency = (Total work / Total time taken)

Efficiency = work done in a single day 

**Calculation:**

Let the efficiency of B is x,

So the efficiency of A will be (x - x/2) = x / 2 

As per the question,

Efficiency ratio of A : B = 1: 2

So day ratio will be 2:1

If A takes 2y days then B takes y days 

As per the question,

(1 / 2y) + (1 / y) = 1 / 16

⇒ 3 / 2y = 1 / 16

⇒ 1 /y = 1 / 24

⇒ y = 24

So A takes 2y days = 2 × 24 

⇒ 48 days

**∴ In 48days can A, working alone, complete the entire work.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

(Efficiency of a Person is inversely proportional to the number of days to complete the work)
